FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Compliance Manager, SecureTech Alarm Solutions, 1234 Security Blvd, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62701-5432, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@securetechalarms.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
SecureTech Alarm Solutions specializes in the installation and maintenance of advanced alarm systems for residential and commercial properties. Our core operations include comprehensive consultations to assess security needs, the design and installation of customized alarm systems, and ongoing monitoring services to ensure robust protection. We emphasize regulatory compliance with NFPA standards, particularly NFPA 101 Life Safety Code, by conducting regular training for our staff and maintaining documentation of all installations and system tests. Our team is trained in fire safety protocols, and we have an established emergency response plan that includes annual fire drills. Furthermore, we perform regular risk assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities in security measures, ensuring our clients receive the highest standard of service and safety. With strong vendor relationships and a commitment to quality, we prioritize the reliability and performance of our systems, enhancing our reputation in the industry.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any restricted activities or conditions and confirms full compliance with NFPA 101 Life Safety Code and all relevant NFPA standards. We maintain comprehensive documentation of regular maintenance, testing, and monitoring of all installed alarm systems, including protective safeguard endorsements. Additionally, proof of fire safety training for all staff involved in installation and maintenance is readily available upon request.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 5, 2023, a malfunction in the installed alarm system led to an unintended activation, causing damage to an interior wall during the response efforts by the fire department. The estimated loss amount is $4,000. This incident is currently under review, with ongoing discussions about liability and responsibility for the damages.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Saturday by appointment.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1, UL Listed for Burglar and Fire Alarm Systems
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24/7 monitored security personnel.
